info.description: Public cacheable catalogue reads and authenticated private developer organization operations. Private developer routes are no-store and require server-resolved canonical identity.

post.description: Creates the organization and its initial active owner in one transaction. The response is private and never shared-cacheable.
Owner or Admin authorization is enforced inside the transaction service. Only non-owner membership roles are accepted; the invite is delivered to the supplied email.
Only the current Owner can initiate. The recipient must accept with a verified email session before ownership changes.
Requires a verified Better Auth email session. The single-use token is sent in the request body rather than a URL to reduce access-log and referrer leakage.
